correctness.rationale: The pointwise rank and midpoint argument establishes global ReLU injectivity exactly when every planar open angular chamber has at least two active independent rows, including boundary directions. Conditional central sign symmetry makes the ordered crossing bits independent fair. For uniform angles, adjacent Dirichlet gap sums have Beta(2,m-2) marginal and adjacent-event overlap exactly 2^{-(m-2)}; nonadjacent bad events and triple overlaps are impossible for m>=4. Exact inclusion-exclusion gives failure m(m-2)/2^{m-1}. The conditional sign law transfers it to nonidentical symmetric row distributions, giving an integer orientation count. Exhaustive finite checker and random diagnostics were run from this package but are not the proof.

originality.rationale: The precise finite-width probability for planar zero-bias ReLU and its distribution-free extension to independently oriented arbitrary unoriented line configurations are not stated by the inspected Puthawala 2022, Maillard et al. 2023/2025 or Xie 2026 primary literature. Classical Wendel computes only origin depth zero (at least one point in every semicircle), not the at-least-two condition. Search under halfspace-depth-two, circular spacings and Gaussian ReLU aliases yielded no matching theorem. This is a best-evidence priority assessment, not a claim of exhaustive history.

value.rationale: A finite input dimension-two instance of a recently established asymptotic Gaussian-layer injectivity problem receives exact all-width probabilities; the first nonzero width is five, with exact value 1/16. The distribution-free conditional theorem further shows universality under arbitrary independent centrally symmetric row laws, much broader than Gaussian angular models. This is a natural quantitative random injectivity observable, not a variable renaming or table lookup; the exact m-dependent deficit can calibrate small-width random layers.
